turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, good to have you here. How are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The bathroom faucet keeps dripping all night and it's driving me nuts.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's usually a worn washer or cartridge. Do you want to try fixing it yourself, or would you rather call a plumber?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, quick break, I need to talk to my roommate. I'll tell you when I'm done.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Have you seen my phone charger?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: I think it's in the bedroom.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Lucas, look at the fish tank. Does the water look cloudy to you?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: A little, yeah. When did you last change it?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Maybe three weeks ago? I kind of lost track.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: That's probably it. Do a partial change this weekend and go easy on the food.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Do you still have that siphon thing?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: It's under my sink, I'll bring it over.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm back, sorry for the wait.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure thing. We were deciding whether you'd fix the dripping faucet yourself or call a plumber.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Honestly, I'd rather just call someone. I don't trust myself with pipes.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Fair enough. Ask for a quote up front, a simple drip repair shouldn't take them long.
